name: PR416 main focused census

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-main-focused-census
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-main-focused-census.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  discover-match-engine-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: List MatchEngine tests
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-main-discovery
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --list-tests \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-main-discovery/list-tests.log
      - name: Upload discovery evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-main-discovery-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-main-discovery/
          if-no-files-found: error

  focused-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        test_name:
          - AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed
          - BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose
          - sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run focused MatchEngine regression
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-main-${{ matrix.test_name }}
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=${{ matrix.test_name }}" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=${{ matrix.test_name }}.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-main-${{ matrix.test_name }} \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-main-${{ matrix.test_name }}/console.log
      - name: Upload focused evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-main-${{ matrix.test_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-main-${{ matrix.test_name }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
